scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run build:skill && vitest run
scripts.check: npm run build:client && npm run build:skill && npm run types && tsc --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.build:daemon: esbuild src/daemon/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __hpCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __hpCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/daemon.mjs
scripts.build:skill: npm run build:daemon && cp dist/daemon.mjs skills/html-preview/scripts/daemon.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:daemon && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.build:node: npm run build:client && npm run build:daemon && esbuild src/node.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.mjs
